title: Police determine that a Maine Bigfoot was actually man in a 'very convincing costume'
excerpt: Bigfoot sightings in Damariscotta, Maine prompted a police department investigation. An officer determined the creature was a man in a very convincing costume.
content:
NEW BIGFOOT SIGHTING?! EXCLUSIVE Tyrus Interview with Witness | Planet Tyrus

NEW BIGFOOT SIGHTING?! Tyrus EXCLUSIVELY speaks to eyewitness Kelly: the hiker who captured the viral 4'9" "Syracuse Figure" on camera in upstate New York! On this special episode of Planet Tyrus, photographer Kelly steps forward for an exclusive interview detailing her terrifying encounter with an unidentifiable figure in a secluded swamp. She walks Tyrus and BFRO founder Matt Moneymaker through the exact moment the entity turned to lock eyes with her, why she fled, and how the photos surfaced online. Lead investigator Matt Moneymaker breaks down the physical evidence, comparing Kelly's encounter to Native American legends of mini-Bigfoots, and feral swamp inhabitants.

Most Bigfoot mysteries go unsolved. There's either no evidence or evidence that isn't sufficient, like a blurry picture or a print in mud that sort of looks like an oversized foot.

This one is one of the ones that police were able to get to the bottom of. It started with several sightings being reported to the Damariscotta Police Department in Damariscotta, Maine last week.

Due to what the police department reported on Facebook were an "unusually high number of calls" they launched an investigation and determined that "Bigfoot is not real."

CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS

I think what they meant to say is that this Bigfoot is not real. Perhaps that the supposed Bigfoot was wearing was a giveaway. An officer located the Bigfoot and, after a conversation, determined that it was a man in a costume.

Not just any costume, a "very convincing costume."

A sasquatch walks through the wilderness in this image processed with a vintage tone. (Getty Images)

The police department took some positive aspects away from the investigation despite the disappointment that a hat wearing Bigfoot was nothing more than a man in a costume.

BIGFOOT HUNTER SUGGESTS THERE'S A CONSPIRACY AFTER CORNELL UNIVERSITY DENIES CONDUCTING DNA TESTS ON REMAINS

"We greatly appreciate everyone’s excitement, curiosity, and willingness to keep an eye out for one another," they wrote. "We also appreciate all the calls and information that came in. Rest assured, we were on the hunt from the very beginning."

A Sasquatch Bigfoot stands in an autumn forest. (Getty Images)

A community coming together and looking out for one another. Maybe that's what Bigfoot has been trying to get across to us the entire time.

"While we didn't find Bigfoot, we did find something almost as rare: A town full of people willing to stop what they're doing to investigate a Bigfoot sighting and keep each other safe," the police department's post continued.

"And honestly, we wouldn't have it any other way."

They may not have had a Bigfoot wandering around their town and the several sightings turned out to be nothing, but the folks of Damariscotta have something more important than that.

They have one another.

Sean Joseph is a writer for OutKick.
